name: dependency_timeout
observation: Dependency span duration exceeded the observed client timeout.
check: Compare request-linked dependency duration with the active client timeout
supports: The linked dependency duration exceeds the configured timeout
weakens: The linked dependency completes before the timeout and the failure occurs elsewhere
measure: Request timeout rate and request-linked dependency latency

name: resource_exhaustion
observation: An OOM termination was observed for the failing worker in the incident window.
check: Compare the worker memory peak and termination timestamp with the configured limit
supports: The failing worker reaches its limit and is OOM terminated during the failing request
weakens: The failing worker remains below its limit and has no incident-time OOM termination
measure: Worker memory, OOM terminations and request error rate

name: configuration_error
observation: The application rejected an observed configuration value during startup.
check: Compare the rejected active configuration value with the documented allowed values
supports: The active value is outside the documented allowed values
weakens: The active value is allowed and the rejection concerns another setting
measure: Startup success and error rate for the affected service
